content: Robust SQL job-queue schema needs: status, attempts/max_attempts, locked_by/locked_at (lease), last_error, created_at/updated_at -- exactly SPEC.md §5.7's job_queue columns. Crash recovery pattern: a periodic reaper/scheduler resets jobs stuck in running past a lease timeout back to pending (SPEC.md's scheduler.php resets locks older than 10 min). Exceeding max_attempts marks the job failed, acting as a dead-letter queue -- matches SPEC.md's fallback to human triage after 3 failed classify attempts.
